entries.text: Lantern light spills across an empty strongbox and onto {first}, {f:pose}
Tight on {first}'s fingers lifting a stranger's purse, the lamplight catching {f:look}
Silhouetted against a burning window, {al:species} {l:class} vaults the sill, a stolen reliquary under one arm
A stolen seal glinting at the belt, {first} freezes flat against the wall as a guard's torch sweeps past
Half through a stolen portal, {first} glances back, the doorway glow washing over {f:look}
{first} stares into a cracked mirror whose reflection moves a heartbeat late, showing {f:look}
Moonlight catches {al:species} {l:class} mid-change, one hand already a claw gripping the doorframe
A curse-mark flares under the skin as ash drifts upward around {first}, {f:pose}

Frost blooms where a ghostly hand grips {first}'s {wearing}
Close on {first}'s thumb pressing blood onto a contract, candlelight on {f:look}
Across a table of guttering candles, {al:species} {l:class} grips a hand far too cold, and every flame leans away
At a moonlit crossroads, a stranger's lantern falls on {first}, {f:pose}
A coin spins between {first}'s spread fingers and a smiling figure in shadow, the {l:class}'s face lit by its glint

{first} turns too late, and the flash of a friend's crossbow falls across {f:look}
A banquet table lies overturned mid-toast; {al:species} {l:class} stares at a poisoned cup, the wine still falling
On an empty dock in lashing rain, {al:species} {l:class} watches a traitor's sail shrink to nothing
Hanged in effigy by their own company, {first} watches from the treeline, the pyre's glow on {f:look}
A lone figure in a whiteout, {first} holds up a dying lantern, its last warm light on {f:look}
Seen from far above, {al:species} {l:class} stands at the heart of a ruined maze, every path curling back
Waist-deep in black water, {first} lifts a torch toward a cave mouth that was not there yesterday
In a hall no map remembers, dust sifts through a single sunbeam onto {first}, {f:pose}
Adrift on a shattered mast, {first} squints at a lighthouse that should be dark, salt spray on {f:look}
Under the aurora, wind-driven snow erases the trail behind {first}, {f:pose}
As something old wakes inside, light pours from the eyes and mouth of {first}, {f:pose}
Close on the {l:class}'s hands as dormant runes kindle under the skin, one by one, out to the fingertips
Behind {al:species} {l:class}, their own shadow peels off the wall and reaches for the lamp
Every candle blown sideways, a storm of loose pages whirls around {first}, {f:pose}
Sigils blaze awake across the tower floor beneath {first}, {f:pose}
A column of dawn light strikes {first} through the chapel roof, gilding {f:look}
A sleeping village glows in the valley behind {first}, {f:pose}
{al:species} {l:class} fills a narrow doorway, torchlight on raised steel, a crowd of enemy shadows on the wall
{first}'s palm rests flat on a sealed door, the last torch guttering over {f:look}
At a lonely gate, snow rimes {first}'s {wearing}
A dragon's shadow sweeps over {al:species} {l:class} standing firm before a fallen king
Every candle in the oracle's cave bends toward {first}, {f:pose}
A comet splits the sky over {al:species} {l:class}, the whole crowd below turning to point
Tight on {first}'s torchlit hand, frozen beside a crumbling fresco of a hero with {f:look}
A blind seer seizes {first}'s wrist across the fire, sparks rising as a finger traces {f:look}
An angel's feather drifts down onto {first}'s open palm, a shaft of gold light falling with it
Painted in ochre on a torchlit cave wall: {al:species} {l:class}, drawn a thousand years before {first} was born
